# Robustness, Interpretation, and Reporting

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Conduct sensitivity analyses.
- Interpret estimates and confidence intervals.
- Assess the robustness of findings.
- Present results in tables and figures.
- Report ITS methods and findings transparently.

## Introduction

A rigorous ITS analysis requires more than fitting a model. Researchers must assess the robustness of their findings, interpret effect estimates carefully, and report their analytical decisions transparently.
